correctness.rationale: Each private clique Q_v forms a complete block with core vertex v. Under independent Roman domination with m>=2, exactly one positive label, necessarily 2, occupies each block; independent core 2-positions form S and m private choices remain per v not in S. With m=1, core 1 is impossible because its private zero leaf would lack a 2-neighbor. Core 2s form independent S, and each remaining leaf is forced 2 outside N_H(S) or has 1/2 choice inside N_H(S). These bijections directly yield both generating functions and the scalar minimum n+i(H). A closed-walk encoding of adjacent core bits gives the explicit 3×3 polynomial transition and full cyclic enumerator. In a cyclic independent S, gap lengths g_j contribute min(2,g_j) to |N(S)|; maximizing gives floor(2n/3) and counts by n mod 3. Independent brute enumeration of all {0,1,2} assignments for 20 small base/clique cases (n<=5, m<=2 within 10 total vertices) agreed with both formulas; separate exact independent-set enumeration confirmed min weight and multiplicity for C_n up to n=12. Infinite correctness follows from bijections/gap counting, not finite checks.
